answer.camera_language: Small, visible approaches nurture their curiosity; the strongest push lands on the marriage demand, then restrained withdrawals leave the warmth and the roadside space behind.

clips.trigger: L1, after the phone changes hands
clips.motivation: Approach only once the practical exchange becomes a personal thank-you.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left, Kasun right, offered phone between them and vehicle behind right
clips.lands_on: A slightly closer shared frame retaining both faces and the exchanged phone
clips.composition_note: Keep both faces balanced across the frame and the waist-height handover visible.
clips.why: Let the return read plainly, then bring us a little nearer when gratitude opens the connection.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level two-shot, the camera creeps slowly closer to both of them as she thanks him.

clips.motivation: Place the encounter within the modest scale of the wet roadside.
clips.opens_on: Full figures, Anudi left and Kasun right, vehicle behind right and wet foreground
clips.lands_on: A marginally wider roadside view with both figures still legible
clips.composition_note: Preserve the left-right geography while adding foreground rather than changing the action.
clips.why: A brief retreat establishes their small roadside world without giving this geographic insert undue grandeur.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level wide shot, the camera slowly pulls back as the offered phone remains between them, then settles.

clips.trigger: Anudi's look toward the business after L2
clips.motivation: Let her new interest redirect the shared frame toward his livelihood.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left and Kasun right in an oblique medium-wide frame
clips.lands_on: Both faces retained, with greater emphasis on the vehicle over Kasun's outer shoulder
clips.composition_note: Use a short pan, retaining Anudi at the left edge and giving her look space toward the vehicle.
clips.why: Use 50mm instead of the proposed 55mm for a little more margin to follow her glance without losing either face.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level medium-wide two-shot, the camera slowly pans right as her attention turns toward the business.

clips.trigger: Her subjective inspection of the business
clips.motivation: Make the business feel like something she is actively considering rather than incidental scenery.
clips.opens_on: Vehicle centre-right beyond a soft umbrella edge at near left
clips.lands_on: A closer subjective view of the vehicle with the umbrella edge still peripheral
clips.composition_note: Keep the soft umbrella edge at the border rather than advancing through it.
clips.why: A short straight approach gives her glance intention without inventing any business activity.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level subjective view framed by a soft umbrella edge, the camera slowly pushes closer to the food vehicle, then settles.

clips.motivation: Give her first personal question a gentle increase in intimacy.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left of centre in MCU, looking right beneath the umbrella
clips.lands_on: A slightly tighter MCU with her rightward look room intact
clips.composition_note: Preserve space to screen right and keep the umbrella edge above her face.
clips.why: Her curiosity deserves an approach, but not yet a change of shot size.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, the camera creeps slowly toward her face as she asks about the business.

clips.motivation: Let his modest admission land with quiet dignity.
clips.opens_on: Kasun right of centre in MCU, looking left with the vehicle soft behind
clips.lands_on: A loose CU retaining leftward look room
clips.composition_note: Keep his eyeline left and the vehicle an unobtrusive background presence.
clips.why: Come closer to the person behind the small beginning, then give his answer room to sit.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes toward his face as he answers, settling into a loose close-up.

clips.motivation: Mark the deepening of her interest beyond polite conversation.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left of centre in MCU beneath the umbrella edge
clips.lands_on: A loose CU preserving her rightward eyeline
clips.composition_note: Approach straight along the existing angle without squeezing her rightward look room.
clips.why: Her second question earns a clearer approach than her first, while remaining conversational.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes into a loose close-up as she asks whether he works alone.

clips.trigger: L7, as he explains his small financial start
clips.motivation: Bring his hope forward gradually and let the ambition land on his face.
clips.opens_on: Kasun right of centre in MCU with look room left
clips.lands_on: Kasun in CU against the softened vehicle
clips.composition_note: Keep the approach straight and his leftward eyeline stable throughout the longer speech.
clips.why: The unbroken approach lets honest pride grow without turning his business into a promotional reveal.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes into a close-up as he explains his hopes, then comes to rest.

clips.motivation: Register admiration as a private, restrained response.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in CU, left of centre beneath the umbrella
clips.lands_on: A subtly tighter CU retaining look room right
clips.composition_note: Leave breathing space above her face beneath the umbrella edge.
clips.why: A brief, modest approach acknowledges the connection without exaggerating her reaction.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level close-up, the camera creeps slowly closer as her smile grows, then settles.

clips.motivation: Give the caller's identity an unambiguous readable pause at the interruption.
clips.opens_on: Phone display large in Anudi's right hand, showing Father
clips.lands_on: The same phone insert after her thumb accepts the call
clips.composition_note: Keep the display dominant and the roadside soft.
clips.why: This is an information beat, so stillness gives the father's identity more force than decorative movement.
clips.camera_sentence: A slightly high insert holds steady on the phone throughout the incoming call and acceptance.

clips.direction: slightly upward with the raised phone
clips.motivation: Accompany the ordinary transition into the call before its meaning changes.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in MCU with connected phone at chest height
clips.lands_on: Anudi in MCU with phone at her ear and slightly more headroom
clips.composition_note: Use only a small upward adjustment, retaining her face throughout and settling for the greeting.
clips.why: A small tilt follows the phone naturally without prematurely treating the greeting as bad news.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly tilts slightly upward as she raises the phone, settling as she greets her father.

clips.trigger: L11 begins over her listening face
clips.motivation: Let the father's urgency begin narrowing her private space.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in CU with the phone at her right ear
clips.lands_on: A slightly tighter CU with the phone and rightward look room retained
clips.composition_note: Stay on her listening face; the remote speaker remains entirely offscreen.
clips.why: The first approach should feel like mounting attention, saving the decisive compression for the marriage demand.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level close-up, the camera creeps slowly toward her listening face as her father begins speaking.

clips.trigger: L11 reaches the demand to discuss marriage
clips.motivation: Make the loss of warmth the scene's decisive visual turn.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in MCU, phone at right ear and space to screen right
clips.lands_on: A tight CU of her changed expression with the phone edge retained
clips.composition_note: Use the scene's greatest forward travel, reducing surrounding space without changing her screen direction.
clips.why: This is the strongest push because the marriage demand, not the ringing phone, changes everything.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes into a tight close-up as the marriage demand lands and her smile fades.

clips.motivation: Let the tiny change in her grip carry the physical pressure of the call.
clips.opens_on: Fingertips central, handset edge at right third and narrow cheek strip at left
clips.lands_on: The same extreme detail with her fingertips closer against the handset
clips.composition_note: Hold the narrow plane of fingertips and handset edge against soft roadside bokeh.
clips.why: At this magnification the fingers supply the movement, and camera stillness makes that small pressure legible.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level extreme close-up holds steady on the fingertips and handset edge as her grip tightens.

clips.motivation: Let subdued compliance sit without another emotional underline.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in CU with phone at right ear and lowered gaze
clips.lands_on: The same close frame after her agreement
clips.composition_note: Retain the established rightward space, now felt as emotional absence.
clips.why: After the strongest approach, arresting the camera makes her compliance feel contained rather than melodramatic.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level close-up holds steady as she quietly agrees to return home.

clips.trigger: Kasun watches her after she ends the call
clips.motivation: Re-establish their connection while acknowledging the distance the call has introduced.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left with phone at chest height, Kasun right watching her
clips.lands_on: A slightly looser two-shot holding their renewed eye contact
clips.composition_note: Retain the original left-right relationship and let a little more roadside surround them.
clips.why: The shared frame returns, but a small retreat admits that its earlier ease has gone.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level two-shot, the camera slowly pulls back as he notices her expression and she looks back at him.

clips.trigger: His faint smile starts to settle
clips.motivation: Observe his concern without suggesting he knows what the father said.
clips.opens_on: Kasun at right in CU, negative space left and vehicle blur behind
clips.lands_on: A slightly tighter CU of his attentive face
clips.composition_note: Preserve the empty leftward eyeline rather than centring him during the approach.
clips.why: Come close enough to notice concern, but make no dramatic reveal that would imply understanding of the call.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level close-up, the camera creeps slowly toward his face as his faint smile settles.

clips.motivation: Allow her farewell to begin separating them while retaining its trace of warmth.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left of centre in MCU, looking right beneath the umbrella
clips.lands_on: Anudi in a loose MS with more surrounding roadside
clips.composition_note: Maintain her rightward look room as the frame loosens.
clips.why: Withdraw gently with the farewell rather than pushing her remaining warmth into a declaration.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pulls back to a medium shot as she says goodbye.

clips.motivation: Give the surviving warmth a quiet afterbeat without enlarging its meaning.
clips.opens_on: Anudi in CU beneath the umbrella, face left of centre and eyeline right
clips.lands_on: The same close view of her small closed-mouth smile
clips.composition_note: Keep rightward space and the umbrella edge above her isolated face.
clips.why: Her small smile is sufficient; holding avoids turning a possible future meeting into a promise.
clips.camera_sentence: An eye-level close-up holds steady beneath the umbrella as her small smile lingers.

clips.motivation: Keep his considerate answer gently connected to her despite the impending departure.
clips.opens_on: Kasun right of centre in MCU, looking left
clips.lands_on: A slightly closer MCU with his leftward look room intact
clips.composition_note: Keep the approach modest and preserve the familiar vehicle blur.
clips.why: A small approach sustains his warmth without giving a simple farewell the weight of a revelation.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level medium close-up, the camera creeps slowly closer as he wishes her well.

clips.direction: right with Kasun toward the vehicle
clips.trigger: Kasun turns toward the business after Anudi exits
clips.motivation: Transfer the scene's attention from the departing pair back to the man remaining at work.
clips.opens_on: Both full figures, Anudi left facing away and Kasun right with vehicle deep right
clips.lands_on: Kasun approaching the vehicle in a wide frame after Anudi's exit
clips.composition_note: Let her leave the original frame before making a short rightward pan with his return.
clips.why: Do not chase her departure; follow his reluctant return so the scene belongs to the person left behind.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level wide shot, the camera slowly pans right with him as he turns back toward the business, then settles.

clips.trigger: Kasun remains beside the vehicle after returning
clips.motivation: Let the empty departure space expand around the encounter's unresolved aftereffect.
clips.opens_on: Kasun and vehicle deep right, empty wet roadside across the left two-thirds
clips.lands_on: A wider roadside view with Kasun smaller beside the vehicle
clips.composition_note: Keep Kasun at deep right as the empty left side and wet foreground expand.
clips.why: End by giving the space back to the roadside while leaving him visibly absorbed beside his business.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level wide shot, the camera slowly pulls back to an extreme wide view as he remains beside the business, then settles.

notes: 4H-1: lens 100mm macro -> 100mm (the frame brief must follow)
